train: A handheld tool often features a rotating blade designed for cutting through various materials with precision.
Many models incorporate a motor that provides the necessary power to drive the cutting mechanism effectively.

Safety features often include a blade guard that protects the user from accidental contact during operation.
Adjustable speed settings allow for versatility in cutting different materials, accommodating both delicate and robust tasks.
A trigger mechanism usually enables the user to control the power and speed of the tool while in use.
